'''Hyperspace technicians''' were highly-specialized [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] who understood the theories and realities of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel. Members of the [[Astrophysics/Legends|astrophysics]] community, hyperspace technicians admitted that certain aspects of hyperspace remained a mystery even to them.<ref name="SWS" />
